articles.title: Data silos threaten banks’ competitive edge in AI
articles.summary: Nearly three in four consumers using AI for banking tasks opt for ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini — almost double those using a bank's chatbot, a McKinsey report found.

articles.title: Google-backed Arva AI raises $20m
articles.summary: Arva AI, a research company building models and agents to help banks and fintechs automate things like financial crime compliance and lending, has raised $20 million in a Series A led by Arthur Ventures.

articles.title: Google lets users connect their Wallet to Gemini for personal finance insights
articles.summary: Google has partnered with Plaid to let US users of its Gemini AI assistant connect their Google Wallet and financial accounts to get responses informed by their spending habits.

articles.title: AI-powered accounting fintech Count raises $6.5m in seed funding
articles.summary: Accounting fintech Count has raised $6.5 million in an oversubscribed seed round for its AI-native platform.

articles.title: Bridge Operating Partners launches AI-powered platform for wealth management C-suites
articles.summary: Bridge Operating Partners launched today to bring actionable executive intelligence to C-suite leaders of wealth management firms, multi-family offices and financial platforms to help turn strategic priorities into disciplined execution.

articles.title: Gr4vy unveils AI-powered payments intelligence assistant
articles.summary: Gr4vy, the cloud-based payment orchestration platform, today announced the launch of Grace, Gr4vy's AI-powered payments intelligence assistant, giving merchants instant visibility into what's driving payment performance across their entire payment ecosystem.

articles.title: AI-powered issuer processor txn launches in the UK and Europe
articles.summary: Txn, a new issuer processor co-founded by Direct Transact and Paycorp, has launched in the United Kingdom and Europe. The API-led, AI-powered business is designed for fintechs, banks and corporates to launch, manage and scale modern card programs.

articles.title: 1 in 10: How The Future of AI Usage in Payments Transactions Will Evolve
articles.summary: In this interview, Mastercard's Linda Kirkpatrick discusses the impact of trust on the AI conversation, and how, across decades in her role, she has witnessed the industry change.
